reviews.review_description: I thought your website was very helpful and informative. It was recommended to me by a family member but fairly late in terms of my research and I was already on the verge of purchasing through Any Energy at that stage. Two companies contacted me. I think the first could not manage a split system but I may be confused with someone else and the other rang after I had accepted one of the quotes from Any Energy. I would give them 5 stars but find 'fantastic' too much of a superlative to use in relation to value, quality and installation as it is too early in the life of the system to evaluate, however, we have been recording its output since installation and it has greatly exceeded the average daily output that was estimated in the quote.
